data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure step for step (search, open venue, set date/guests, Notify, choose time and confirm) and names the right parameters, but it adds an extra "location" parameter, and "Dinner/Lunch" and "preferred time" are a little loose, though still concrete enough to automate.
